description: This file defines a FastAPI router for metrics endpoints, including the setup for dependency injection of a MetricsService, a GET endpoint to retrieve current metrics, and associated utility functions.

methods.name: MetricsService _get_metrics_service()
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton MetricsService instance; raises an error if not initialized.

methods.name: None set_metrics_service(service: MetricsService)
methods.description: Sets the global MetricsService instance used by the router.

methods.name: EnvelopeCurrentMetrics get_current_metrics( response: Response, testRunId: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional test run id (UUID)."), includePerStream: bool = Query(default=False, description="Whether to include per-stream breakdown."), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current aggregated metrics snapshot.
